title: Prioritise which campaigns play first
summary: Set the order in which active campaigns are presented for a display type from the Campaign Prioritisation button on the Campaigns list.
bodyMd:
Campaign Prioritisation on the Campaigns list sets the order in which active campaigns are presented for a display type. The documented effect is on the campaign carousel of the mobile store site linked to that display type. The order is set per display type, so each screen size or channel can have its own.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account.
  • The campaigns you want to order are activated — see Activate or deactivate a campaign. Only active campaigns appear in the order.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns.
  2. At the top right, select Campaign Prioritisation.
  3. Find and select the display type you want to update.
  4. Select Update Priorities.
  5. Use the up and down arrows to re-order the campaigns.
  6. Select DONE.
The Creative → Campaign Assets tab of a campaign also shows a Priority number on each playlist card.

Verify it worked

Active campaigns are presented in the order you set within the campaign carousel on the mobile store site associated with the selected display type. Open the store site to check — see Test your mobile site.

Next step

Review campaign performance in Insights / Analytics
